{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from ultralytics import YOLO

model = YOLO(r'D:\acceleration\best.pt')
pm = model.model
pm.eval()

for p in [r'D:\acceleration\dataset\val\rust\rust_00003.png', r'D:\acceleration\dataset\val\scratch\scratch_00023.png']:
    img = Image.open(p).resize((224, 224)).convert('RGB')
    t = torch.from_numpy(np.array(img, dtype=np.float32)/255.0).permute(2,0,1).unsqueeze(0)
    t.requires_grad = True

    features, logits_list = [], []
    def fh_c2f(m, i, o): features.append(o)
    def fh_lin(m, i, o): logits_list.append(o)

    # Hook last conv feature map inside Classify (conv is 1280 channels!) or C2f (256 channels)
    target_layer = pm.model[8]
    h1 = target_layer.register_forward_hook(fh_c2f)
    h2 = pm.model[9].linear.register_forward_hook(fh_lin)

    out = pm(t)
    
    # Target raw pre-softmax logit
    raw_logits = logits_list[-1]
    top_cls = int(raw_logits.argmax())
    
    # Backward on pre-softmax logit!
    pm.zero_grad()
    score = raw_logits[0, top_cls]
    # Compute grad w.r.t features
    feat = features[-1]
    grads = torch.autograd.grad(score, feat, retain_graph=False)[0]

    h1.remove()
    h2.remove()

    w = grads.mean(dim=(2, 3), keepdim=True)
    cam = (w * feat).sum(dim=1)[0]
    cam = F.relu(cam).detach().cpu().numpy()
    print(p)
    print('  Pre-softmax CAM min:', cam.min(), 'max:', cam.max(), 'mean:', cam.mean())
